chunks: From him, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'adah ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far, from his fathers (peace be upon them), that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"Do not combine in marriage upon doubt. He said: When it reaches you that you have suckled from her milk, and that she is a prohibition for you, and similar to that, then standing firm upon the doubt is better than plunging into destruction."

key_terms.الشُّبْهَةِ: Doubt or uncertainty regarding a legal status
key_terms.الْوُقُوفَ: Standing firm / remaining in the current state
key_terms.رَضَعْتَ: You have suckled (establishing kinship through breastfeeding)
key_terms.مَحْرَمٌ: Prohibition (one who cannot be married due to kinship)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marriage when there is doubt about breastfeeding establishing a mahram relationship?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the principle of *al-wuqūf ʿind al-shubhah* (holding firm at the point of doubt) in marital validity, particularly regarding *radāʿ* (breastfeeding) which creates a mahram relationship. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on caution (*iḥtiyāṭ*) in personal status law, prioritizing the preservation of lineage and prohibition over the risk of invalid marriage.
